summary: iter335.15 — Maker Leaderboard widget + admin toggle. Full back+front e2e verified end-to-end against live preview. 8/8 new backend tests pass. Live API ranks 10 makers correctly with proper badges/scores. Admin toggle flips flag, widget hides cleanly on /makers when disabled, restores when enabled. leaderboard_enabled left = True in db.site_settings.global as required.

design_issues.screen: Admin Settings toast on leaderboard toggle
issues: Toast text reads 'leaderboard enabled disabled' — awkward but follows existing concatenation pattern across all toggle rows. Not a blocker, just a polish item.

All 10 makers currently get badge='Rising' because there are no paid orders or reviews in the last 30 days on the live preview DB — only new-listing signal. This is the formula working as designed. Consider seeding 1-2 paid orders for a top maker so the live preview demos the 'Top Seller' / 'Reviewer Favorite' variants too.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/leaderboard.py: _orders_per_maker assumes paid_at is stored as ISO string ($gte string compare). Works because the rest of the codebase stores ISO-8601 strings, but a future shift to datetime objects would silently break the window filter. Consider centralising the 'since' construction or adding a defensive isinstance check.

routers/leaderboard.py:172-187 iterates `slugs` (a set) and skips makers whose meta is missing. Score=0 makers are also skipped (line 186). Net result is correct but the early `continue` on missing meta means we silently drop rejected makers — fine, but worth a comment so the rejected/deleted-maker exclusion behaviour is obvious to future readers (the test_excludes_rejected_makers test already covers it).

MakerLeaderboard.jsx swallows ALL non-503 errors as `hidden=true`. Acceptable for a non-critical widget, but means a transient backend hiccup will hide the widget silently. Consider distinguishing 503 (explicit disable → hide) from 5xx/network (transient → maybe retry once or just log). Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing 10 approved makers + their published listings already on live preview gave a valid leaderboard. No cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live preview leaderboard_enabled=True after this run. Pre-existing unrelated regression: test_settings.py::test_eleven_channels_supported fails because /api/community/chat/design-share/history returns 404 — unrelated to iter335.15.
